{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v2, a field annotated Optional[T] with no default is required (migration.md#required-optional-and-nullable-fields). Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior where these fields default to None. This also fixes the test failure: profile_from_form drops keys whose values are "" or None, so omitted bio/website/age now fall back to None instead of raising 'Field required'. The imports are unchanged because Optional is still used."}], "notes": "Single edit covers lines 8-10 (contiguous). The test-failure finding (app/profiles.py:15) is resolved by the same change, so profile_from_form needs no modification; its filtering logic is valid in v2 and is preserved as-is. The `interests: List[str] = []` default is already non-required and works unchanged in v2 (pydantic copies mutable defaults), so it was left alone. No deprecated v1 APIs appear in this file, so no other edits are needed."}
